title: Why Prices Always End in 9
mechanism: We read prices left to right and weigh the first digit most, so a one-cent cut that changes it feels like a big discount and lifts sales.

beats.hook: You grabbed a jacket for forty-nine ninety-nine: basically forty bucks
beats.story: You skip the fifty-dollar one and pay, grinning
beats.twist: The back door swings open: the owner is re-tagging every price with a price gun, 50.00 to 49.99
beats.mechanism: Giant price 2.99 vs 3.00 with a spotlight on the left digit, an eye tracing left to right, three dresses tagged $44 $49 $54 with order stacks, odometer 49,999 to 50,000 with a price board dropping
beats.ending: Next door a 9.99 sign, and you're reaching for your card

seed.what: The STAFF ONLY back door with the price gun hanging on a hook beside it

locations.set: Room warm + clothes rack + mirror + staff door
Room cold + tag table + price gun
Room night + giant price digits + spotlight
Room dream + three dresses on stands + order stacks
Room neon + giant odometer + price board
Room alarm + shop window with 9.99 sign
